admissions.reason: Biopsy results contradicted urothelial carcinoma, making amyloid protein deposition a more definitive finding.
Biopsy confirmed amyloid protein deposition in the urethra, supporting primary amyloidosis of the urethra.
Retrograde urethrography showed a 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra.
R2 is a more specific diagnosis, indicating the location of the amyloidosis.
